question: Will the 12-month change in the U.S. Consumer Price Index (CPI-U, all items, seasonally adjusted; computed from the index) for February 2026 (the latest monthly reading dated on or before 2026-02-14) be at least 2.30% and below 3.00%?

rule.threshold_basis: rounded lower and upper quartiles of historical moves over the same distance

source: Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics
